---

## 1. System Overview
Minions.AI is an autonomous, ultra-low-latency AI voice dispatcher and front-office automation platform engineered co-primarily for **pest control operators (PCOs)** and **real estate agencies**, with verified support for HVAC, plumbing, roofing, and electrical businesses.

### Primary Problem Solved
Small-to-midsize service businesses and real estate teams lose 30% to 50% of high-intent inbound opportunities because owners and agents are actively working in the field (on a route, inspecting an attic, or mid-showing with clients) and cannot answer the phone within the critical 15-second window. Callers rarely leave voicemails; 85%+ hang up and immediately call the next competitor.

### Core Metrics & Benchmarks
- **Voice Answering Speed**: Under 1.8 seconds (1–2 rings), 24 hours a day, 365 days a year.
- **Speed to Lead Impact**: Responding within 5 minutes makes a business 21× more likely to qualify a lead and 100× more likely to reach the caller compared to a 30-minute delay (MIT Lead Response Study).
- **Revenue Protection**: Recovers $15,000 commission opportunities for real estate agencies and $2,500+ recurring annual customer contracts for pest control operators.
- **Calendar & CRM Sync**: Native two-way booking with Google Calendar, Follow Up Boss, FieldRoutes, PestPac, GorillaDesk, ServiceTitan, Jobber, and Housecall Pro with zero double-bookings.

---

## 2. The AI Crew (Modular Specialist Architecture)
Minions.AI uses dedicated specialized agents rather than a single generic chatbot:

1. **Rex (AI Phone Dispatcher)**:
   - Live 24/7 inbound phone answering on existing office or mobile lines via SIP/call-forwarding.
   - For Pest Control: Identifies pest species, assesses severity, books inspection slots, upsells recurring quarterly plans, and syncs to FieldRoutes/PestPac/GorillaDesk.
   - For Real Estate: Executes conversational LPMAMA qualification (Location, Price, Motivation, Agent status, Mortgage pre-approval, Appointment), enforces Fair Housing Act compliance, schedules showings, and syncs to Follow Up Boss.
   - For Trades: Emergency triage for burst pipes, AC compressor failures, and arcing breakers with live owner escalation.

2. **Zip (Instant SMS Speed-to-Lead)**:
   - Fires an automated text message within 4 seconds if a call ever drops or disconnects.
   - Engages callers via two-way SMS to lock in appointments before they call a competitor.

3. **Pip (Grounded Web Concierge)**:
   - Answers website inquiries and routine quote questions 24/7.
   - Strictly grounded in verified business data and rate sheets with zero hallucination.

4. **Gia (Review & Pipeline Nurturing)**:
   - Dispatches post-service review requests via SMS after successful jobs.
   - Follows up with pending estimates and unclosed buyer leads to increase close rates.

5. **Otto (Back-Office Intake & Paperwork)**:
   - Converts voice call transcriptions and chat logs into structured CRM customer profiles and dispatch tickets.

---

## 3. Co-Primary Target Markets

### A. Real Estate Agencies
- **Target Profile**: Boutique brokerages and top-producing teams (1–10 agents).
- **Workflows**: 24/7 showing booking, Open House inquiry triage, LPMAMA buyer lead scoring, strict adherence to Fair Housing Act guidelines, direct sync to Follow Up Boss and Google Calendar.
- **Dedicated Page**: https://www.getminions.ai/industries/real-estate

### B. Pest Control Operators (PCOs)
- **Target Profile**: Residential and commercial pest control companies (1–15 trucks).
- **Workflows**: 24/7 emergency infestation triage (rodents, bed bugs, termites, stinging insects), recurring quarterly agreement upsells, direct scheduling in FieldRoutes, PestPac, and GorillaDesk.
- **Dedicated Page**: https://www.getminions.ai/industries/pest-control

### C. Supported Secondary Trades
- **HVAC**: https://www.getminions.ai/industries/hvac (Extreme heat/freeze emergency repair triage, $8,500 replacement lead intake).
- **Plumbing**: https://www.getminions.ai/industries/plumbing (2 AM burst pipe and main shutoff triage, drain clearing dispatch).
- **Roofing**: https://www.getminions.ai/industries/roofing (Storm surge intake, photo damage upload SMS).
- **Electrical**: https://www.getminions.ai/industries/electrical (Emergency panel outage and hazard safety triage).

---

## 4. Architectural Differences: Minions.AI vs Generic Call Centers

| Feature | Generic Call Center / Monolithic Bot | Minions.AI Front Desk |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Response Latency** | 3.5 – 6.0 seconds (unnatural delay) | < 1.8 seconds (natural conversation flow) |
| **Acoustic Filtering** | Fails on job site noise, traffic, or spotty LTE | Deep noise cancellation trained on real tools and truck audio |
| **Calendar & CRM Sync** | Fragile webhook wrappers that break silently | Native deterministic two-way state locking |
| **Compliance** | Generic scripts risking Fair Housing violations | Hardcoded compliance guardrails for Real Estate |
| **Pricing Model** | Expensive per-minute enterprise contracts | Transparent one-time setup fee + direct wholesale telephony |

## 5. Pricing Structure
- **Starter Build**: $1,000 one-time build fee (Rex 24/7 Voice Dispatcher, CRM/Calendar sync, call forwarding, 14-day delivery).
- **Full Crew Build**: $2,000 one-time build fee (Rex + Zip SMS recovery + Pip web concierge + Gia reviews + Otto intake, 21-day delivery).
- **Ongoing Carrier Telephony**: Direct carrier wholesale usage via Retell AI / Twilio (~$0.08–$0.14/min) with zero markup and no mandatory monthly retainers.
- **Details**: https://www.getminions.ai/pricing
